grade.first_issue: No decisive defect; no grading rule imposes a cap.
grade.summary: The proof is complete and correct. The lexicographically decreasing potential establishes finite termination and exactly one surviving entry greater than 1. Primewise gcds of the valuation vectors are then correctly shown to be invariant and to determine the unique terminal value.
strengths: Correctly handles all cases of a move and proves strict descent of (N,V).
Correctly proves that at least one entry greater than 1 always remains.
Correctly identifies the valuation transformation as (x,y) to (min(x,y),|x-y|).
Correctly uses invariance of the gcd of each prime's exponents to reconstruct M uniquely.
